sentences.zh: 从根本上改变了这些欧洲盟友的性质。

sentences.en: Yeah, let's just pause there because that line really made a lot of waves.
sentences.zh: 而总统所想到的那个欧洲，那个他父母从中走出来的欧洲——他的母亲是苏格兰移民，

sentences.en: So what does the Trump administration mean when it says there is civilizational erasure happening in Europe?
sentences.zh: 他的父亲是19世纪80年代末来到美国的德国移民的第一代后裔——那个欧洲几乎已经消失了。

sentences.en: Well, this has been a topic of great debate about how you interpret that.
sentences.zh: 许多人将那一行解读为一种抱怨，即总统在想到欧洲时所想象的白人欧洲盟友正在减少。

sentences.en: But I think the most common interpretation is that the president is saying that the migration that has changed the face of Germany, of France, even of Britain,
sentences.zh: 我认为这份文件所做的是在说，欧洲正在威胁其自身的未来存在和身份。

sentences.en: has fundamentally altered the nature of these European allies.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大卫，你开始指出这一点了，但请解释一下为什么“移民正在改变欧洲的人口结构和文化”这一概念，

sentences.en: And that the Europe that the president came to think of, the one from which his parents emerged, his mother was a Scottish immigrant.
sentences.zh: 对特朗普政府来说很重要？

sentences.en: His father was the first generation descendant of German immigrants to the United States in the late 1880s, that that Europe was almost gone.
sentences.zh: 它与美国的外交政策有什么关系？

sentences.en: And many read that line as a complaint that there is a diminishment of the white European allies that the president imagines when he thinks of Europe.
sentences.zh: 我认为这与他们对“拥有共同价值观的国家”的形象有关，不仅是与美国，而且是与特朗普总统和“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）运动的共同价值观。

sentences.en: And I think what this document is doing is saying Europe's threatening its own future existence and identity.
sentences.zh: 去年二月，J.D.万斯在慕尼黑安全会议上的演讲中有很多这样的内容。

sentences.en: Well, you're starting to point at this, David, but just explain why this concept that migration is changing the demographic makeup of Europe and and the culture, perhaps,
sentences.zh: 那真是令人震惊，他说，你们最大的对手不是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: of Europe.
sentences.zh: 你们最大的对手是正在改变你们社会的移民浪潮。

sentences.en: Why is it important for the Trump administration?
sentences.zh: 我认为那些将多样性视为一种力量、一种欧洲复兴的欧洲人，听到这些话感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: Like, what does it have to do with American foreign policy?
sentences.zh: 而国家安全战略的这一整部分读起来就像是二月份万斯在慕尼黑演讲的扩展。

sentences.en: I think it has to do with their image of countries with common values, not only with the United States, but with President Trump and the MAGA movement.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: And there was a lot of this in the J.D.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: Vance speech to the Munich Security Conference last February.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: That was such a shock where he said, your big adversary is not Russia.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: Your big adversary is the waves of migration that are changing your societies.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: And I think the Europeans who viewed that diversity as a strength, a revitalization of Europe, were truly shocked to hear that.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: And this whole section of the national security strategy reads like it is a expansion of the Vance speech in Munich in February.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: Can I just ask, I understand that there were many Europeans who were shocked by this when Vance brought it up and perhaps have been shocked by it in this document.
sentences.zh: 我可以问一下吗？我理解当万斯提出这个问题时，许多欧洲人感到震惊，或许这份文件中的内容也让他们感到震惊。

sentences.en: But it's true, right, that there has been this massive wave of migration across Europe and there is a lot of discontent with it.
sentences.zh: 但这是事实，对吧？欧洲确实经历了一波大规模的移民潮，而且对此存在很多不满。

sentences.en: There are a lot of people who aren't in favor of it and don't see it as something they want in their countries.
sentences.zh: 有很多人并不支持这种现象，也不希望在自己的国家看到这种情况。

sentences.en: That's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And, you know, you sense this whenever you're in Europe and you just read it in the headlines, see it in protests on the streets,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，无论你身处欧洲，还是仅仅从头条新闻中阅读，或是在街头的抗议活动中看到，你都能感受到这一点，

sentences.en: see it in the clashes between these new migrants who are coming in and traditional Europeans.
sentences.zh: 在这些新涌入的移民与传统欧洲人之间的冲突中也能看到这一点。

sentences.en: So the core of the Trump argument in this document is basically a warning to the Europeans that you are ignoring your own voters, that you're suppressing free speech, right,
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普在这份文件中论点的核心，基本上是对欧洲人的警告：你们忽视了自己的选民，你们在压制言论自由，对吧？

sentences.en: by suppressing the right wing, by trying to keep them down, by refusing to allow them to take power.
sentences.zh: 通过压制右翼，试图打压他们，拒绝让他们掌权。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's true in their minds in Germany, in their minds, it's true in France and in their minds, it's even true in Great Britain.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，这在德国是事实，在法国是事实，甚至在英国也是事实。

sentences.en: And just explain why that's problematic in the eyes of the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 那么，请解释一下为什么在特朗普政府眼中这会是个问题。

sentences.en: Well, to the Trump administration, I think there are sort of two reasons.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于特朗普政府来说，我认为主要有两个原因。

sentences.en: The stated reason is that a Europe that is divided like this, that is suppressing the will of its own voters, that's keeping the right wing from coming up,
sentences.zh: 明面上的理由是，一个像这样分裂的欧洲，一个压制自身选民意愿、阻止右翼崛起的欧洲，

sentences.en: is basically an unstable Europe.
sentences.zh: 本质上是一个不稳定的欧洲。

sentences.en: That can't, as the document says, operate as a group of aligned sovereign nations,
sentences.zh: 正如文件所说，它无法作为一个结盟的主权国家集团运作，

sentences.en: taking primary responsibility for their own defense without being dominated by an adversarial power.
sentences.zh: 在不被敌对势力主导的情况下，无法承担起自身防务的主要责任。

sentences.en: But I think we have to allow for the possibility, Natalie, that what's really going on here is they want like-minded MAGA-oriented governments in these nations.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们必须考虑到一种可能性，娜塔莉，那就是这里真正发生的事情是，他们希望在这些国家建立志同道合、以“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）为导向的政府。

sentences.en: And they think the current European establishment is standing in the way of that goal.
sentences.zh: 他们认为当前的欧洲建制派正阻碍着这一目标的实现。

sentences.en: And so what, if anything, is the Trump administration saying they're going to do about that problem?
sentences.zh: 那么，特朗普政府对于解决这个问题有什么说法吗？如果有的话，是什么？

sentences.en: Well, they're vague about what they do about it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们对于具体怎么做说得很模糊。

sentences.en: There is this line saying that among their priorities is cultivating resistance to Europe's current trajectory within European nations.
sentences.zh: 文件中有一行字说，他们的优先事项之一是在欧洲国家内部培养对欧洲当前发展轨迹的抵制力量。

sentences.en: But we don't really know what that means.
sentences.zh: 但我们并不真正知道这意味着什么。

sentences.en: Does it mean that the president is going to endorse right wing patriotic candidates as if he was endorsing
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着总统将支持右翼爱国候选人，就像他支持

sentences.en: Republican or MAGA-oriented governors or senators running for election in the United States?
sentences.zh: 在美国竞选的共和党或以MAGA为导向的州长或参议员那样？

sentences.en: Would he be interfering in their elections?
sentences.zh: 他会干预他们的选举吗？

sentences.en: He doesn't say, except in the trade arena, where, of course, he's quite specific about his goals.
sentences.zh: 他没有说，除了在贸易领域，当然，他在那里对自己的目标非常明确。

sentences.en: So just to sum up what you've told us about the Europe policy that's articulated here, this is much of what we've seen already in the Trump administration saying, basically,
sentences.zh: 所以，总结一下你告诉我们的关于这里阐述的欧洲政策，这很大程度上是我们已经看到的特朗普政府的说法，基本上就是：

sentences.en: Europe, you're on your own in terms of paying for your own defense.
sentences.zh: 欧洲，在支付自身防务费用方面，你们得靠自己了。

sentences.en: We're not going to be as involved as we have been.
sentences.zh: 我们不会像过去那样深度参与了。

sentences.en: And then you're also seeing this expressed concern over mass migration in Europe and civilizational erasure.
sentences.zh: 而且你还看到了这种对欧洲大规模移民和文明抹除的担忧。

sentences.en: So what do you make of this altogether?
sentences.zh: 那么，你对这一切有何看法？

sentences.en: How should we interpret it?
sentences.zh: 我们应该如何解读它？

sentences.en: It's hard to tell because parts of it are contradictory.
sentences.zh: 很难说，因为其中一些部分是相互矛盾的。

sentences.en: But you emerge from reading the document,
sentences.zh: 但读完这份文件后，你会觉得，

sentences.en: thinking that the United States is carving out an exception for itself to step in and intervene in Europe to get to the kind of society that President Trump and his allies think they want and think that many Europeans want.
sentences.zh: 美国正在为自己开辟一个例外，以便介入欧洲，去实现特朗普总统及其盟友认为他们想要的，以及他们认为许多欧洲人也想要的社会形态。

sentences.en: And yet, buried in this assertion of a right to interfere with Europe's internal politics, even directly engaging with European voters,
sentences.zh: 然而，在这种干涉欧洲内部政治、甚至直接与欧洲选民接触的权利主张背后，

sentences.en: there's this sort of strange undertone of retreat, a real sense that overall the U.S.
sentences.zh: 隐藏着一种奇怪的退缩基调，一种美国总体上

sentences.en: is turning away from Europe.
sentences.zh: 正在背离欧洲的真实感觉。

sentences.en: And so then the question becomes, if the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么问题就变成了，如果美国

sentences.en: is retreating from our traditional European allies, where are we turning?
sentences.zh: 正在从我们传统的欧洲盟友那里撤退，那我们转向哪里呢？

sentences.en: Well, for the past decade, the Europeans have been worried that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，过去十年里，欧洲人一直担心美国

sentences.en: is turning to Asia, that it's focusing on China and Japan and South Korea, the booming economies.
sentences.zh: 正在转向亚洲，专注于中国、日本和韩国这些经济繁荣的国家。

sentences.en: But what this document says is that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但这份文件所说的是，美国

sentences.en: is ready once again to turn its attention to our own region, to focus on our own backyard.
sentences.zh: 准备再次将注意力转向我们自己的区域，专注于我们自己的后院。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wenna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘文娜（Wenna Liu）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”游戏。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”（promesthesia）的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: David, before the break, you said that this document articulates that our backyard is now the focus of America's foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 大卫，在休息之前，你说这份文件明确指出我们的后院现在是美国外交政策的焦点。

sentences.en: So what exactly does the Trump administration want to do in our backyard, and how does it define our backyard?
sentences.zh: 那么特朗普政府到底想在我们的后院做什么？他们又是如何定义我们的后院的？

sentences.en: Well, let's start with the second question first, Natalie, because you're talking about a president who spent his life as a real estate mogul.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我们先回答第二个问题，娜塔莉，因为你谈论的是一位终生从事房地产大亨工作的总统。

sentences.en: And the real estate he has in mind here is pretty big.
sentences.zh: 他心目中的房地产范围相当大。

sentences.en: It goes from Canada over to Greenland.
sentences.zh: 它从加拿大一直延伸到格陵兰岛。

sentences.en: It runs down through the newly named Gulf of America, through the Panama Canal, which, of course, he said we never should have given away, all the way down to the tip of Argentina.
sentences.zh: 它穿过新命名的“美国湾”，穿过巴拿马运河——当然，他说过我们本不该放弃它——一直延伸到阿根廷的顶端。

sentences.en: And the president's idea here is that the United States should have complete and total dominance of the Western Hemisphere.
sentences.zh: 总统的想法是，美国应该对西半球拥有完全且彻底的统治权。

sentences.en: And so the president advocates in this document that we return to and expand on the Monroe Doctrine.
sentences.zh: 因此，总统在文件中主张我们回归并扩展“门罗主义”。

sentences.en: Now, at the risk of making some of our listeners shake in fear as they try to recall 11th grade history.
sentences.zh: 现在，冒着让一些听众在试图回忆11年级历史时吓得发抖的风险，

sentences.en: Yeah, let's get the spark notes.
sentences.zh: 是的，让我们看看重点摘要吧。

sentences.en: Absolutely, we're slipping you the copy right now, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们现在就把副本递给你，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: The Monroe Doctrine, which dates back to 1823, declared that the Western Hemisphere would essentially be closed to European colonization.
sentences.zh: 门罗主义可以追溯到1823年，它宣布西半球基本上将对欧洲殖民关闭。

sentences.en: The Europeans had to stay out of our territory, which was a pretty bold thing to say for a country that was about 45 years old and barely had a navy at the time, right?
sentences.zh: 欧洲人必须远离我们的领土，对于一个当时只有45年历史且几乎没有海军的国家来说，这可是相当大胆的说法，对吧？

sentences.en: But over the following 200 years, we both expanded from and retreated from the Monroe Doctrine.
sentences.zh: 但在随后的200年里，我们既扩展了门罗主义，也从门罗主义中退缩过。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: Teddy Roosevelt in 1905 issued a Roosevelt corollary to this doctrine that basically said we reserve the right to intervene in Latin America if we see governments that are coming together that are not to our liking.
sentences.zh: 西奥多·罗斯福在1905年发布了该主义的“罗斯福推论”，基本上说，如果我们看到正在形成的政府不合我们的心意，我们保留干预拉丁美洲的权利。

sentences.en: And we did exactly that, right?
sentences.zh: 我们确实就是这么做的，对吧？

sentences.en: We got involved in a civil uprising in Colombia, and we ended up with the Panama Canal.
sentences.zh: 我们卷入了哥伦比亚的一场内乱，最终得到了巴拿马运河。

sentences.en: I mean, we did a whole bunch of actions up through the 1950s when the CIA was conducting coups in the region.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们一直到20世纪50年代都在进行一系列行动，当时中央情报局在该地区策划政变。

sentences.en: But then we turned away for a bit.
sentences.zh: 但后来我们退缩了一段时间。

sentences.en: We had the Cold War.
sentences.zh: 我们经历了冷战。

sentences.en: We had the collapse of the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 我们经历了苏联解体。

sentences.en: We had 9-11.
sentences.zh: 我们经历了9·11事件。

sentences.en: And we began to think as China rose that it's really in the Indo-Pacific that we needed to concentrate our forces.
sentences.zh: 随着中国的崛起，我们开始认为，我们真正需要集中力量的地方是印太地区。

sentences.en: What this document is saying is it's time to come home again and to focus on our home region.
sentences.zh: 这份文件所说的是，现在是时候再次回家，专注于我们自己的家园区域了。

sentences.en: And when you read the actual document, the president talks about building on the Monroe Doctrine and creating a sort of Trump corollary to it.
sentences.zh: 当你阅读实际文件时，总统谈到了在门罗主义的基础上建立一种特朗普式的推论。

sentences.en: What it's saying is we are going to control access to the region.
sentences.zh: 它所说的是，我们将控制进入该区域的通道。

sentences.en: We're going to stop drugs to the region.
sentences.zh: 我们将阻止毒品进入该区域。

sentences.en: And we're going to make sure that you see the U.S.
sentences.zh: 并且我们将确保你在该区域看到美国

sentences.en: military in the region.
sentences.zh: 军队的身影。

sentences.en: And here's where the document gets more specific than in almost any other place in the 30 pages.
sentences.zh: 而这正是这份30页的文件中比其他任何地方都更具体的地方。

sentences.en: There's a page where it says we're going to readjust our global military presence to address these urgent threats in our own hemisphere because we live here.
sentences.zh: 有一页写道，我们将调整我们的全球军事存在，以应对我们自己半球的这些紧迫威胁，因为我们住在这里。

sentences.en: Well, that may not sound like a big decision, but we've had a succession of American presidents, Democrats, Republicans alike,
sentences.zh: 嗯，这听起来可能不是什么重大决定，但我们经历了一连串的美国总统，无论是民主党人还是共和党人，

sentences.en: who have said we are going to go focus on the Indo-Pacific because that's where our future is.
sentences.zh: 他们都曾说我们要去关注印太地区，因为那是我们的未来所在。

sentences.en: That's where our trade is.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的贸易所在。

sentences.en: That's where China and India are, right?
sentences.zh: 那是中国和印度所在的地方，对吧？

sentences.en: So this would basically put a halt to that kind of expansion in a world of limited resources and bring those forces back home.
sentences.zh: 所以，这基本上会在资源有限的世界中停止那种扩张，并将这些力量带回国内。

sentences.en: It says that we're going to design a more suitable Coast Guard and Navy presence to control sea lanes.
sentences.zh: 它说我们将设计更合适的海岸警卫队和海军存在来控制海上航道。

sentences.en: It says we're going to defeat cartels and put people at the border to do that.
sentences.zh: 它说我们将打击贩毒集团，并为此在边境部署人员。

sentences.en: And where necessary, the use of lethal force to replace the failed law enforcement-only strategy of the last several decades.
sentences.zh: 并在必要时使用致命武力，以取代过去几十年来失败的纯执法策略。

sentences.en: So what it does is essentially give a retroactive justification or rationale for what we've seen with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以它本质上是为我们所看到的美国

sentences.en: military sinking these boats in the Caribbean and killing alleged drug runners.
sentences.zh: 军队在加勒比海击沉这些船只并杀害涉嫌毒贩的行为，提供了一种追溯性的辩护或理由。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's giving a strategic rationale for things he has wanted to do and is doing anyway.
sentences.zh: 这为他一直想做且无论如何都在做的事情提供了一个战略理由。

sentences.en: But it even goes beyond that, Natalie, because there are sections of it that explicitly say that to make this work, we're going to kick other powers out of our region.
sentences.zh: 但这甚至不止于此，娜塔莉，因为其中有明确的章节说，为了让这一切奏效，我们将把其他大国赶出我们的区域。

sentences.en: And that's code word for China.
sentences.zh: 而那是中国的代号。

sentences.en: Because in the past, Natalie, when the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为在过去，娜塔莉，当美国

sentences.en: turned its attention away from the Western Hemisphere, when its focus was on China and the Indo-Pacific,
sentences.zh: 将注意力从西半球移开，当它的焦点在中国和印太地区时，

sentences.en: the irony is that the Chinese were moving into Latin America and really made huge inroads there economically.
sentences.zh: 讽刺的是，中国人正在进入拉丁美洲，并在经济上取得了巨大的进展。

sentences.en: And that makes it all the stranger that the document doesn't really name China specifically as the big player in the region.
sentences.zh: 这使得该文件没有明确点名中国是该地区的大玩家，显得更加奇怪。

sentences.en: And there's been some debate about why that is.
sentences.zh: 关于为什么会这样，一直有一些争论。

sentences.en: Some people think it was the work of Scott Besson, the Treasury Secretary, who's trying to negotiate trade deals with China.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为这是财政部长斯科特·贝森（Scott Besson）的工作，他正试图与中国谈判贸易协议。

sentences.en: He doesn't want to particularly anger them before President Trump's scheduled visit to Beijing in April.
sentences.zh: 他不想在特朗普总统四月份预定的北京之行前特别激怒他们。

sentences.en: But what it certainly does is it suggests the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但可以肯定的是，这表明美国

sentences.en: is going to boot out anybody who it thinks shouldn't be there.
sentences.zh: 打算把任何它认为不该在那里的势力踢出去。

sentences.en: And what does it actually mean to kick China out of Latin America?
sentences.zh: 那么把中国赶出拉丁美洲到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, in some cases, the president has declared he wants Chinese companies physically out of, say, the Panama Canal,
sentences.zh: 嗯，在某些情况下，总统已经宣布他希望中国公司彻底离开，比如巴拿马运河，

sentences.en: where he exaggerated the control of the Chinese military, which has very little presence there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里夸大了中国军队的控制力，而中国军队在那里几乎没有什么存在感。

sentences.en: But what he really means is that by expanding the American economic presence,
sentences.zh: 但他真正想说的是，通过扩大美国的经济存在，

sentences.en: by making sure that everyone in the region buys American products and runs on American operating systems, that basically he would squeeze out the Chinese and other competitors.
sentences.zh: 通过确保该地区的每个人都购买美国产品并运行美国操作系统，他基本上会挤走中国和其他竞争对手。

sentences.en: And, of course, you travel in Latin America.
sentences.zh: 而且，当然，你去过拉丁美洲旅行。

sentences.en: What do you see?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: You see Huawei phones.
sentences.zh: 你看到了华为手机。

sentences.en: You see Chinese 5G networks.
sentences.zh: 你看到了中国的5G网络。

sentences.en: And it's those areas where I think the president wants to get that replaced with American hardware and software.
sentences.zh: 我认为总统正是想在这些领域用美国的硬件和软件来取代它们。

sentences.en: David, just to step back here for a moment, can you help me understand how the taking up of the Monroe Doctrine,
sentences.zh: 大卫，退一步说，你能帮我理解一下，采取门罗主义，

sentences.en: this new muscular posture that we're going to be taking in Latin America with new military deployments,
sentences.zh: 这种我们将通过新的军事部署在拉丁美洲采取的强硬姿态，

sentences.en: isn't that out of step with the original understanding that I think a lot of us had of America first as this policy of isolationism?
sentences.zh: 难道不与我们许多人认为的“美国优先”作为一种孤立主义政策的初衷背道而驰吗？

sentences.en: There is certainly a split in MAGA world about isolationism and interventionism.
sentences.zh: 在MAGA世界里，关于孤立主义和干涉主义确实存在分歧。

sentences.en: And there are a lot of the president's followers who would like to just build big walls around the continental United States,
sentences.zh: 总统的许多追随者希望在美国大陆周围建立高墙，

sentences.en: maybe include Hawaii and Alaska in that, and basically say, everybody stay away and we're not going to mess in your business.
sentences.zh: 也许把夏威夷和阿拉斯加也包括在内，基本上说，大家都离远点，我们不会插手你们的事。

sentences.en: You saw MAGA members who were opposed to taking out the nuclear facilities in Iran.
sentences.zh: 你看到过反对摧毁伊朗核设施的MAGA成员。

sentences.en: The president basically told them to sit down and shut up while he bombed them and then came home.
sentences.zh: 总统基本上告诉他们坐下闭嘴，然后他轰炸了那些设施并回国了。

sentences.en: But what we're discussing in Latin America is really pulling MAGA apart here because they see in our conflicts over the boats, in the president's promise repeated just this week
sentences.zh: 但我们在拉丁美洲讨论的问题确实让MAGA内部产生了分裂，因为他们看到了我们在船只冲突中的表现，看到了总统本周重申的承诺，

sentences.en: that there would be land strikes, that we could end up in forever wars in our own neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 即会有地面打击，我们最终可能会在我们自己的邻近地区陷入无休止的战争。

sentences.en: So what makes this worth it to Trump?
sentences.zh: 那么是什么让这一切对特朗普来说值得呢？

sentences.en: Like, why risk pulling MAGA apart, as you said, over this?
sentences.zh: 比如，为什么要冒着像你所说的让MAGA分裂的风险来做这件事？

sentences.en: What does the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: actually get out of reasserting its dominance in this really aggressive way?
sentences.zh: 以这种极具侵略性的方式重新确立其统治地位，到底能得到什么？

sentences.en: Well, one possibility of what we get out of it is basically a spheres of influence kind of organization of the world, something we haven't really seen since the late 1800s.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们从中得到的一种可能性基本上是世界的一种势力范围式的组织，这是我们自19世纪末以来就没怎么见过的。

sentences.en: This is a world in which the United States dominates its own territory, that China dominates the Pacific, and that the Europeans dominate Europe.
sentences.zh: 这是一个美国统治其自身领土、中国统治太平洋、欧洲统治欧洲的世界。

sentences.en: But if they don't get their act together, maybe Vladimir Putin dominates Europe.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们不团结起来，也许弗拉基米尔·普京会统治欧洲。

sentences.en: It establishes essentially that we each carve up the globe and sort of respect the other territories as the other guy's problem.
sentences.zh: 它本质上确立了我们每个人瓜分全球，并以某种方式尊重其他领土，将其视为别人的问题。

sentences.en: And, of course, this is a vision that coincides with another world leader's idea of how the globe should be organized.
sentences.zh: 当然，这与另一位世界领导人关于全球应该如何组织的构想不谋而合。

sentences.en: And that's Putin himself, who has frequently talked about the spheres of influence kind of organization of the world.
sentences.zh: 那就是普京本人，他经常谈论这种世界势力范围式的组织。

sentences.en: But how is declaring a sphere of influence coherent with America first?
sentences.zh: 但宣布势力范围怎么能与“美国优先”相一致呢？

sentences.en: I mean, you could see how leaving the rest of the world to its own devices jives with an isolationist's view of how to engage with the world.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可以看出让世界其他地方自生自灭是如何与孤立主义者看待世界互动的方式相契合的。

sentences.en: But help me make sense of the internal logic of declaring American predominance over an entire swath of the globe.
sentences.zh: 但请帮我理解一下，宣布美国对全球一大片区域的统治地位，其内在逻辑是什么？

sentences.en: I think this is where we see the America first doctrine becoming something closer to America's firSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是我们看到“美国优先”（America First）原则变得更接近“美国之首”（America's firSt）的地方。

sentences.en: With an S.
sentences.zh: 带个S。

sentences.en: America's with an S.
sentences.zh: 美国的，带个S。

sentences.en: That he views the region as basically the subsidiary of the United States.
sentences.zh: 他认为该地区基本上是美国的附属机构。

sentences.en: And, you know, I've traveled with President Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我曾随特朗普总统出访。

sentences.en: I've covered five American presidents since I got back to Washington from my life as a foreign correspondent.
sentences.zh: 自从我结束了外国记者的生活回到华盛顿后，我已经报道过五位美国总统了。

sentences.en: And my takeaway is that Trump is really not an isolationiSt.
sentences.zh: 我的结论是，特朗普其实并不是一个孤立主义者。

sentences.en: He never has been.
sentences.zh: 他从来都不是。

sentences.en: He's actually more of a unilateraliSt.
sentences.zh: 他实际上更倾向于单边主义。

sentences.en: What do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, he wants the total freedom of action.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他想要完全的行动自由。

sentences.en: He knows that he is not really interested in democracy promotion.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己对推广民主并不真正感兴趣。

sentences.en: He knows that he wants to prioritize economics and economic development over everything, even if those economics don't necessarily come with security benefits to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己想要把经济和经济发展置于一切之上，即使这些经济利益并不一定能给美国带来安全保障。

sentences.en: But I also think that what's really notable about this strategy is that it doesn't cast our traditional adversaries, China and Russia, but mostly China,
sentences.zh: 但我还认为，这一战略真正值得注意的地方在于，它并没有将我们的传统对手——中国和俄罗斯，尤其是中国——

sentences.en: as global strategic challengers, much less a threat to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 视为全球战略挑战者，更谈不上是美国的威胁。

sentences.en: So one would think from these documents that Europe's troubles pose a greater threat to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以人们从这些文件中会认为，欧洲的麻烦对美国构成的威胁，

sentences.en: than any of the above.
sentences.zh: 比上述任何一方都要大。

sentences.en: David, we've been talking about this document as a major pivot and a reorientation of American foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 大卫，我们一直在讨论这份文件，认为它是美国外交政策的一次重大转折和重新定位。

sentences.en: But I have to ask, as someone who has spent so much time covering American leaders and American actions across the globe,
sentences.zh: 但我必须问你，作为一名长期报道美国领导人和美国全球行动的记者，

sentences.en: how enduring is the shift that we're seeing represented here?
sentences.zh: 我们在这里看到的这种转变有多持久？

sentences.en: Does it last beyond this president?
sentences.zh: 它能延续到这位总统任期之后吗？

sentences.en: The closest analogy I can make is Trump and the White House itself.
sentences.zh: 我能想到的最贴切的比喻就是特朗普本人和白宫本身。

sentences.en: The next president can come in and scrape all the gold off of the Oval Office walls and put turf back down in the Rose Garden.
sentences.zh: 下一任总统上台后，可以把椭圆形办公室墙上的金饰全部刮掉，把玫瑰园重新铺上草皮。

sentences.en: But whoever it is, is not going to be able to go rebuild the East Wing.
sentences.zh: 但无论他是谁，都无法去重建东翼。

sentences.en: There's going to be a ballroom and you're going to have to learn how to live with it or like it.
sentences.zh: 那里总会有一个宴会厅，你必须学会接受它，或者试着喜欢它。

sentences.en: And my guess is that the foreign policy of this president is going to have a similar effect.
sentences.zh: 我猜这位总统的外交政策也会产生类似的影响。

sentences.en: That at this point,
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，

sentences.en: the world is going to assume that the United States always has the ability to turn back in on itself and that each region of the world and even our allies are going to have to learn to depend on themselves.
sentences.zh: 世界将默认美国总是能够转而关注自身，世界上的每一个地区，甚至我们的盟友，都将不得不学会依靠自己。

sentences.en: And I don't think that there is anything we can do over the next generation, no matter who becomes elected president, to make them believe that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我不认为在未来一代人的时间里，无论谁当选总统，我们能做些什么来让他们相信美国

sentences.en: is always going to be with them.
sentences.zh: 会永远与他们站在一起。

sentences.en: I think the fundamental trust in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我认为，作为西方一系列理念捍卫者的美国，

sentences.en: as the defender of a certain set of concepts of the West has been shattered for some time.
sentences.zh: 其根本信任在一段时间内已经破碎了。

sentences.en: David, thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: This is one of the most consequential votes this Senate will take all year.
sentences.zh: 这是参议院今年要进行的最重要的投票之一。

sentences.en: By saying yay or nay to the clerk of the Senate, senators will decide whether people live or people die.
sentences.zh: 通过对参议院书记官投下赞成或反对票，参议员们将决定人们的生死。

sentences.en: On Thursday afternoon, Senate Republicans blocked a Democratic bill to extend federal health care subsidies,
sentences.zh: 周四下午，参议院共和党人阻止了一项旨在延长联邦医疗保健补贴的民主党法案，

sentences.en: making it all but certain that insurance costs will surge for millions of Americans by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 这几乎可以肯定，到今年年底，数百万美国人的保险费用将大幅上涨。

sentences.en: The bill would have extended the subsidies for the Affordable Care Act by three years,
sentences.zh: 该法案本可以将《平价医疗法案》的补贴延长三年，

sentences.en: a rallying cry for Democrats and their central motivation for shutting down the government for 43 days.
sentences.zh: 这是民主党人的战斗口号，也是他们让政府停摆43天的核心动机。

sentences.en: But even with four Senate Republicans backing the measure, Democrats fell short of the 60 votes they needed to pass it.
sentences.zh: 但即使有四名参议院共和党人支持该措施，民主党人仍未达到通过法案所需的60票。

sentences.en: And President Trump signed an executive order that seeks to block states from enforcing laws that regulate the artificial intelligence industry.
sentences.zh: 此外，特朗普总统签署了一项行政命令，试图阻止各州执行监管人工智能行业的法律。

sentences.en: A win for big tech that puts dozens of AI safety and consumer protection laws at risk.
sentences.zh: 这对大型科技公司来说是一次胜利，但却使数十项人工智能安全和消费者保护法律面临风险。

sentences.en: The order gives the attorney general broad authority to overturn laws that don't support the, quote, United States' global AI dominance.
sentences.zh: 该命令赋予司法部长广泛的权力，可以推翻那些不支持所谓“美国全球人工智能主导地位”的法律。

sentences.en: If states keep their laws in place, Trump directed federal regulators to withhold funds for broadband and other projects.
sentences.zh: 如果各州坚持执行其法律，特朗普指示联邦监管机构扣留用于宽带和其他项目的资金。

sentences.en: Finally, in a stinging defeat for Trump,
sentences.zh: 最后，在特朗普遭遇的一次惨痛失败中，

sentences.en: Republican state lawmakers in Indiana have rejected a new congressional map ordered up by the White House that would have made it harder for Democrats to win any congressional seats in the state.
sentences.zh: 印第安纳州的共和党州议员否决了白宫下令制定的新国会选区图，该图本会让民主党在该州赢得任何国会席位变得更加困难。

sentences.en: The Republican lawmakers who voted against the new map said that it would undermine people's faith in government and warned Trump that he should stay out of the state's politics.
sentences.zh: 投票反对新选区图的共和党议员表示，这会破坏人们对政府的信任，并警告特朗普不要插手该州的政治。
